_comment: Authoritative heavy-machine physics tuning shared by server simulation and client replay. Changing any value is a gameplay change: bump BUILD and ship a matching hosted server release.

heft._comment: Three-times enlarged hulls read as foam under 1 g. Bots fall under gravity_multiplier times arena gravity; launch and jump speeds scale by its square root so heights hold while hang time shrinks.

contact._comment: Tracks carry the weight: while on its drive the hull has track_hull_friction against the arena (the drive model handles grip), and slope_hold_fraction of the downhill pull is cancelled by the tracks up to the grip limit, so tanks park and climb on hills. Off its drive (roof/side) the hull grinds with stranded_hull_friction (Jolt combines sqrt(hull * floor)). bot_contact_friction is explicit Coulomb friction between clashing hulls.

motor._comment: Multipliers over catalogue drive values. rolling_resistance_multiplier scales the released-throttle coast deceleration (motor controllers brake hard) so knocked hulls stop instead of sliding; brakes stay stronger than coasting.

nitro._comment: Nitro is raw machine power: boosted acceleration and top speed carry an Atlas off a jump ramp onto a roof. Multipliers over the (already motor-scaled) drive values while nitro is held with throttle.

impacts._comment: Scales over authored weapon impulses (m/s at equal mass). Rams add knock-back because Jolt hull contacts are plastic. The lifter applies no force while charging (hold 0 keeps the flipper low) and releases one violent launch with flip spin.
